title: run-scene reports ok when the model scene's DSL or mesh failed to load
description: Found by TOOL-43. `ixdar-cli run-scene --scene ring-tool --mesh ixdar-app/src/main/resources/dsl/crawfish/IMG_4111.dsl` on a machine without the scan printed `"ok": true` and an `ok scene=ring-tool ...` summary, with no V/F counts, while the scene log said `[mesh-viewer] DSL load failed for .../IMG_4111.dsl: load_mesh failed for /home/acw/crawfish/IMG_4111.glb`. An agent that reads only the JSON believes the model loaded and goes on to screenshot an empty viewer. run-scene (and launch) should report the model scene's load failure: ok false, the failure message, the log path.
definition-of-done:
1. run-scene with a --mesh whose load fails returns ok false with the load failure message and a non-zero exit.
2. A successful model load is unchanged (ok true, V and F in the summary).
3. A Python CLI test covers the failure path.
testing-plan:
1. run-scene with a DSL naming a missing scan: ok false.
2. run-scene on fertility: ok true as before.
